nodes.label: Static JSON Data Layer (Database Removal)
nodes.rationale: Database support was intentionally removed: server/utils/db.ts is kept only as a compatibility stub and all portfolio/admin data is served from static JSON files in data/ instead of PostgreSQL, eliminating a runtime database dependency.

nodes.label: JWT-Protected Admin Write APIs
nodes.rationale: Admin protection is layered: client-side route guarding in middleware/admin.ts plus server-side JWT bearer token checks in server/middleware/auth.ts scoped to selected write endpoints and methods, so write paths stay protected even if the client guard is bypassed.

nodes.label: SEO Module Selection Decisions
nodes.rationale: @nuxtjs/seo was removed because of dependency conflicts and @nuxtjs/robots was dropped in favor of a manual public/robots.txt, while @nuxtjs/sitemap was kept for automatic sitemap generation - a leaner, conflict-free SEO module set.
